title: Greetings
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Latin, thank them, answer yes or no, and say goodbye.

payoff.summary: The whole doorway sequence on cue: write salvē independently from its sound, use salvē or avē on arrival, say grātiās tibi agō, answer ita or nōn, and use valē on the way out.
